exposure: Families who chose some interventions vs. those who chose comfort care
outcome: Concordance between delivery events and family birth plans
cohort: 187 families receiving perinatal palliative care for life-limiting fetal diagnoses, such as trisomy 13 or 18 and some major structural anomalies between 2016 and 2020.
finding: Most families' perinatal experiences matched their birth plans and expectations in this perinatal palliative care program.
